programmes.d: Under hypnosis at the dentist (guest star Monty Hall), Ann is mistakenly told to buy anything at the drop of a hat at the same time Donald is trying to help her work on a budget.

Oscar tells Myrna the story of why Felix has been banned from Midtown Memorial Hospital ever since his daughter's birth in The First Baby.

Felix turns to Oscar for help after complaining he no longer can communicate with his daughter.

Marcia becomes convinced she's ugly, ugly, ugly! after having to wear braces.
Peter’s ego inflates after saving a girl from an accident.
The kids are at each others' throats. The basic cause of the problem is that the house is seemingly too small with six kids sharing two bedrooms and one bathroom.

Ann's cover is blown and she is tricked into photographing rejected dress designs.
